name: @repo/ai-tool-call
description: Collapsible tool invocation whose status badge is one ring that evolves — breathing, spinning, then drawing a check or a cross.

useCases: Tool or function call inside an agent transcript
MCP tool invocation with arguments and result
Compact status row for a background step
compositionHints: The badge never unmounts, so the eye tracks one object through the lifecycle
Omit args and result to render a plain non-expandable status row
Stack several inside a conversation for an agent trace
